conviction_note: Most likely this release has no new utility deal and no strategic-review outcome. The EDGAR 8-K record shows no deal since 2026-04-21, and in September the CEO, the CLO and a director sold outside any 10b5-1 plan, which argues against a transaction being near. On this name, prints without a deal have been sold (Aug -4.45%, Feb -1.45%), and the 25d skew is +26.6 vol points to puts. Against that sit several small positives: a $250m buyback renewed 2026-09-16 that a preview missed, the SpaceX-Grain $8B low-band comparable, the D2D/FCC optionality, and an 8.7%-of-float short. So the per-finding sum is slightly positive (+0.55) while the scaled number is slightly negative (p_up 46 x abs 7.0 = -0.56). The two disagree because one likely negative is set against many small optional positives. Both are near zero, and an honest zero is close.
bar: Revenue about $2.0m and EPS -$0.45, both from the Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-11-03 (https://finviz.com/news/414384/anterix-heads-into-earnings-with-strategic-review-not-revenue-driving-the-debate). Only one estimate source was found for Q2. The company gives no formal guidance. Revenue is amortisation of deferred revenue ($174.9m deferred, $14.3m current, per the Q1 10-Q), so the revenue line is close to mechanical. GAAP EPS swings on narrowband-to-broadband exchange gains whose treatment in consensus is unclear. The bar is therefore single-source, and every finding that leans on it is capped small. The stock trades on deals and the strategic review, not on this bar.
positioning_check: Short interest is 8.68% of float with a short ratio of 5.46 days (finviz quote page, https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=ATEX, read 2026-11-10). Equibles showed 1.53m shares and 5.12 days to cover at the 2026-03-13 settlement (https://equibles.com/stocks/atex/shortinterest). Baseline: 25d skew +26.63 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.10 (open interest is call-heavy), total OI only 2,516, and an ATM spread of 46% of mid, so the 2.97% event-implied move is only indicative. The 10-day straddle is 12.54% at 90.8% IV, and 20d realised vol is 90.7%. The tape is weak into the print: -8.34% over 5 days, -11.22% over 20, -6.3% on the event day itself with no news found, and 30% off the 52w high ($113, per finviz) but +247% YTD. Insider transactions read -36.82% on finviz. The short is moderately crowded, not extreme, and is enough to shrink the negatives.

findings.finding: No new utility spectrum agreement has been disclosed since 2026-04-21. Anterix files an 8-K item 8.01 for every utility sale, down to the $0.77m Benton PUD deal (8-Ks 2026-02-02, 04-01, 04-06, 04-21). Its only 8.01 since then is the 2026-09-18 buyback. So the fiscal Q2 (Jul-Sep) release very likely reports a second straight quarter with zero new customers, unless a deal signed after September 30 is held for the release. The Earnings Whispers preview says about a dozen opportunities are 'active'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2026 print: no new customers signed and a profit beat. The stock fell 3.2% after hours, about 11.5% early the next session, and closed -4.45% (baseline; https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/anterix-shares-fall-despite-first-quarter-earnings-beat-93CH-4852887). Feb 2026 print (CPS deal already announced 2026-02-02): -1.45%. Prints carrying new FCC or deal news went the other way: Jun 2026 +25.72%, Nov 2025 +13.68%.
findings.source_date: 2026-11-10 (EDGAR 8-K list read on this date; last deal 8-K dated 2026-04-21)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the preview already says 'none were signed last quarter', and the stock is down 11% over 20 days with put skew of +26.6. What is not fully priced is the 6.5-month dry spell, now two full quarters, during a period management called 'accelerating interest'. If it were fully priced, the Aug-style sell-the-print reaction would not recur. A surprise deal announced with the release is the upside tail and is why the range runs positive.
findings.independence: The Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/414384/anterix-heads-into-earnings-with-strategic-review-not-revenue-driving-the-debate, 2026-11-03) independently says no new utility customers were signed last quarter. A WebSearch for October 2026 Anterix utility agreements found none.

findings.finding: Insiders sold at $80-85 in the post-Q1 open window, outside any 10b5-1 plan. CEO Scott Lang sold 15,000 shares at $80.00 on 2026-09-21 (10b5-1 box 0), leaving 26,470 direct (about 36% of his direct stake). The Chief Legal Officer sold 4,357 at $85.44 on 2026-09-08 (about 46% of her holdings, not under a plan). A director, Leslie Daniels, sold 2,500 at $83.83 on 2026-09-10 (not under a plan). The CFO also sold about 5,000 on 2026-10-09, but under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-06-22. Discretionary sales cleared by the general counsel are hard to square with a strategic transaction being near as of September, so a deal announcement alongside this print is less likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on insider sales. The strategic review has run since February 2025 with no outcome across six prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: finviz shows insider transactions at -36.82% and lists the CEO sale, and a Seeking Alpha piece is titled 'the chart and the insiders say wait'. What may not be priced is the inference, not the fact: a non-plan sale by the CEO and the CLO implies the review held no MNPI in September. If the market had fully absorbed that, the stock would carry no deal premium into the print, and it still trades at about $1.48bn against $116m of cash.
findings.independence: Same insider set seen across three separate Form 4s (CLO https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1304492/000166994326000019/0001669943-26-000019.txt filed 2026-09-08; director https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1304492/000105255926000006/0001052559-26-000006.txt filed 2026-09-11). Seeking Alpha 'insiders say wait' (https://seekingalpha.com/article/4947727-anterix-the-spectrum-case-is-real-but-the-chart-and-the-insiders-say-wait), not fetched (403).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-16 the board approved a new $250m buyback, effective 2026-09-22 through 2029-09-22, replacing the expiring $226.7m program. The company made no repurchases in fiscal Q1 (Q1 10-Q). The 2026-11-03 Earnings Whispers preview still tells investors to 'look for an update' on the expiring authorisation, so at least one widely read preview missed the renewal. Any repurchases from late September onward, or an execution plan, would show in the Q2 10-Q Part II Item 2 or on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved print turned on buyback execution. The prior $226.7m program sat unused in Q1 FY27.
findings.why_not_priced: The authorisation is public in an 8-K, but the Earnings Whispers preview written six weeks later does not know about it. Authorisations at this company have historically gone unused. Actual purchases at $75-85 by a company with $116m of cash and no debt would be new information. If buying were priced, the -11% 20-day drawdown would be harder to explain. A $250m program against a $1.48bn cap is about 17% of the shares. Execution is uncertain: insiders were selling at the same time, and management has said it may need to raise capital.
findings.independence: Q1 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1304492/000130449226000046/atex-20260630.htm, 2026-08-11) confirms no repurchases in Q1, $226.7m remaining, $116.0m cash, no debt.

findings.finding: On the Q1 call (2026-08-12), management said it expected at least single-digit millions of gains from narrowband-to-broadband license exchanges in Q2, after a $10.7m exchange gain in Q1 (6 counties, per the 10-Q). Below-the-line gains like these can push GAAP EPS through the -$0.45 single-source consensus without telling the market anything about deals.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2026: an EPS beat (-$0.53 vs -$0.55) with a $10.7m exchange gain was sold (-4.45%). Jun 2026: a $0.98 EPS beat driven by gains came alongside the FCC order and a +25.7% move, so the gains were not the driver.
findings.source_date: 2026-08-12 (snippet_only: WebFetch returned 403; statement taken from a WebSearch summary of the call)
findings.why_not_priced: It is a one-off with no path to guidance, and this name has sold EPS beats. Its only value is the headline-beat optics on a single-source bar. It is not sized as operating profit.
findings.independence: Q1 10-Q confirms the $10.7m Q1 exchange gain (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1304492/000130449226000046/atex-20260630.htm). Shares the call source with nothing else here.

findings.finding: As of 2026-06-30, the Q1 10-Q lists contracted proceeds still due: Ameren $2.5m (second half of 2026), CPS $6.5m, NorthWestern $7.6m, LCRA expansion $6.5m, SDG&E $3.1m, Xcel $4.0m and smaller items. Management guided about $9.6m of receipts for the rest of FY27. Q2 cash should land roughly flat to modestly down from $116.0m, after about $10m of quarterly opex and about $6.7m/quarter of clearing spend, plus receipts. This sits inside what the company has already guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cash and contracted-proceeds lines have not moved this stock on their own in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the receipts are guided and scheduled. It is filed so the panel can see the cash walk. A cash figure well below about $100m without buybacks would point to clearing costs running ahead (the 10-Q shows $39.0m of future incumbent payments), but nothing indicates that.
findings.independence: Shares the 10-Q with the buyback finding's independence note. The Earnings Whispers preview cites about $116m of cash and no debt.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-08, SpaceX agreed to buy Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz portfolio (up to 14 MHz paired low-band) for about $8B (WSJ/Reuters). That is a fresh low-band per-MHz-pop comparable, and ATEX rose 10.58% on 2026-10-09 when Roth tied it to low-band spectrum values. Management will very likely cite it on the 2026-11-11 call when it frames its stated $4-7.5bn gross asset value against a $1.48bn market cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: +10.58% on the day of the deal news (Oct 9). The stock has since given all of it back (from about $82-86 to $75).
findings.why_not_priced: The comparable itself was priced on Oct 9 and then fully unwound. Management has not spoken since, so the call is the first company framing of the comparable. This is a proxy (another company's deal) and is sized small.
findings.independence: Finviz news list carries the Stocktwits report that ATEX rose 10.58% after SpaceX's $8B deal (https://finviz.com/news/407252/anterix-sets-second-quarter-fiscal-2027-earnings-conference-call-for-wednesday-november-11-at-9-00-am-et).

findings.finding: Satellite D2D optionality is open, and no FCC ruling was found before the print. SpaceX's 2026-08-10 ex parte asked the FCC for a technology-neutral or satellite buildout option on 5x5 MHz 900 MHz broadband licenses, and Anterix filed in support on 2026-08-11. Anterix completed first-round D2D testing with Lynk under an FCC experimental licence granted in May 2026. The preview names FCC movement on the satellite option and new testing milestones as what would validate the bull case. Results from Lynk round two, or any SpaceX/D2D commercial discussion, could arrive on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 2026 print: the FCC flexible-use order (May) plus results gave +25.72%. August: the SpaceX-support statement released with the print did not stop a -4.45% close.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an option, not a fact: no FCC action was found through Nov 10. It is priced as optionality in the 210x P/S. It is filed because a concrete milestone on the call is the main upside path for this print, and the call-heavy OI (put/call 0.10) suggests some holders are positioned for it.
findings.independence: FCC experimental licence and Lynk trial (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/2026751/anterix-eyes-900-mhz-monetization-as-fcc-order-opens-satellite-door, 2026-05-18). Earnings Whispers 'what to watch' (2026-11-03).

findings.finding: Short interest is 8.68% of float with 5.46 days to cover (finviz, read 2026-11-10), going into a print after an 8.3% five-day slide and a -6.3% event day with no news found. Any positive surprise (a deal, a buyback execution, a D2D milestone) meets a short base that needs over five days of volume to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints with positive news gave +13.68% (Nov 2025) and +25.72% (Jun 2026), which fits a squeeze on good news.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew prices downside and ignores the squeeze mechanism. Only the squeeze mechanism is sized here; the unexplained drawdown itself is given no weight.
findings.independence: Equibles 2026-03-13 settlement: 1.53m shares short, 5.12 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/atex/shortinterest).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-21 Anterix announced that the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo are the first Apple devices certified on dedicated Anterix 900 MHz private LTE networks. That widens the device ecosystem utilities need, and management can present it on the call as a deal enabler.

findings.why_not_priced: Public for seven weeks and almost certainly priced. Filed small, for the panel.

baseline_tension: The main negative (no deal, insiders selling) agrees with the +26.6 put skew and the -11% 20-day slide, so it is probably largely priced. The small positives cut against the skew but are optional, so p_up sits only slightly below 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7: the no-deal negative agrees with a strong put skew and the drawdown, so it is mostly priced; shrunk -1.2 to -0.9.
Lesson 7 / priced: the insider-sales finding is already shown on finviz and in Seeking Alpha; shrunk -0.6 to -0.4.
Lesson 2: the exchange gain is a one_off below operating income with no path to guidance; shrunk 0.3 to 0.15.
Lesson 5: an unexplained drawdown is worth 0, so the positioning finding keeps only the squeeze mechanism; shrunk 0.6 to 0.2.
Lesson 5: the SpaceX-Grain comparable is a proxy; shrunk 0.5 to 0.4.
Lessons 1 and 6: the single-source EPS bar on a name that has sold its beats moves p_up from 47 to 46. abs_move unchanged at 7.0.
